content.json:
# Entra External ID: identity security console
Filters apply to every panel except where a panel says otherwise (dormant users, new-country and new-user panels use fixed look-back windows; threat-detection panels ignore the Status filter). Result code `0` = success; `50074`/`50076`/`50058`/`50140` are MFA or session prompts, not real failures, and are excluded from the detections.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City=tostring(LocationDetails.city), Browser=tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), OS=tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| where '{Apps}' == '*' or AppDisplayName contains '{Apps}'
| where '{Countries}' == '*' or Country contains '{Countries}'
| where '{Users}' == '*' or UserPrincipalName contains '{Users}'
| where '{Status}' == 'All' or ('{Status}' == 'Success' and ResultType == '0') or ('{Status}' == 'Failed' and ResultType != '0')
| summarize ['Total sign-ins']=count(), ['Successful']=countif(ResultType=="0"), ['Failed']=countif(ResultType !in ("0","50074","50076","50058","50140")),
            ['MFA / prompts']=countif(ResultType in ("50074","50076","50058","50140")),
            ['Unique users']=dcount(UserId), ['Applications']=dcount(AppDisplayName), ['Unique IPs']=dcount(IPAddress), ['Countries']=dcount(Country)
| extend ['Success rate %']=round(100.0*Successful/max_of(['Total sign-ins'],1),1)
| project r=bag_pack_columns(['Total sign-ins'],['Successful'],['Failed'],['MFA / prompts'],['Success rate %'],['Unique users'],['Applications'],['Unique IPs'],['Countries'])
| mv-expand bagexpansion=array r
| project Metric=tostring(r[0]), Value=toreal(r[1])
content.title: Key metrics
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time window

content.query:
let b = SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City=tostring(LocationDetails.city), Browser=tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), OS=tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| where '{Apps}' == '*' or AppDisplayName contains '{Apps}'
| where '{Countries}' == '*' or Country contains '{Countries}'
| where '{Users}' == '*' or UserPrincipalName contains '{Users}';
union
 (b | where ResultType !in ("0","50074","50076","50058","50140") | summarize v=dcount(UserPrincipalName) | project Metric="Users with failures", Value=toreal(v)),
 (b | where ResultType !in ("0","50074","50076","50058","50140") | summarize F=count(), A=dcount(UserPrincipalName) by IPAddress | where A>=3 and F>=5 | summarize v=count() | project Metric="Password-spray IPs", Value=toreal(v)),
 (b | where ResultType !in ("0","50074","50076","50058","50140") | summarize F=count() by UserPrincipalName | where F>=5 | summarize v=count() | project Metric="Brute-force targets (5+ fails)", Value=toreal(v)),
 (b | where ResultType=="50053" | summarize v=dcount(UserPrincipalName) | project Metric="Locked accounts", Value=toreal(v)),
 (b | where ResultType=="0" | where isnotempty(Country) | summarize C=dcount(Country) by UserPrincipalName | where C>=3 | summarize v=count() | project Metric="Users in 3+ countries", Value=toreal(v))
content.title: Detections in range (each panel below lists the details)
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time window

| where Accounts >= 3 and Failures >= 5

content.query:
SigninLogs
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), City=tostring(LocationDetails.city), Browser=tostring(DeviceDetail.browser), OS=tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| where '{Apps}' == '*' or AppDisplayName contains '{Apps}'
| where '{Countries}' == '*' or Country contains '{Countries}'
| where '{Users}' == '*' or UserPrincipalName contains '{Users}'
| where ResultType=="0" and isnotempty(Country)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Country, City, IPAddress, lat=todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.latitude), lon=todouble(LocationDetails.geoCoordinates.longitude)
| where isnotnull(lat) and isnotnull(lon)
| sort by UserPrincipalName asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend pUser=prev(UserPrincipalName), pTime=prev(TimeGenerated), pCountry=prev(Country), pIP=prev(IPAddress), pLat=prev(lat), pLon=prev(lon)
| where pUser == UserPrincipalName and Country != pCountry
| extend Minutes=datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, pTime), Km=round(geo_distance_2points(pLon, pLat, lon, lat)/1000.0)
| extend SpeedKmH=round(Km / (todouble(max_of(Minutes,1))/60.0))
| where Minutes <= 360 and SpeedKmH > 900
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, From=strcat(pCountry," / ",pIP), To=strcat(Country," / ",IPAddress), Minutes, Km, SpeedKmH
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Impossible travel: successful sign-ins from two countries implying > 900 km/h
content.noDataMessage: No data in the selected time window
